description: This header file defines common C++ classes and utilities for Android's Binder IPC mechanism, including reference counting, interface handling, and class definitions for binder interfaces.

classes.name: SharedRefBase
classes.description: A reference-counted base class using std::shared_ptr for internal reference management, providing methods for creating, referencing, and deleting instances.

classes.name: ICInterface
classes.description: An interface class for Android Binder IPC, providing methods for binder conversion, remote check, dumping, and shell command handling.

classes.name: BnCInterface
classes.description: A template class implementing server-side binder interface, managing binder creation and weak references.

classes.name: BpCInterface
classes.description: A template class implementing client-side binder proxy, holding a binder reference and providing binder access.

methods.name: asBinder
methods.description: Returns the binder object associated with the interface, either existing or newly created.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the interface is in a remote process.

methods.name: handleShellCommand
methods.description: Processes shell commands for the interface.

methods.name: getInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the interface instance associated with a binder.

methods.name: defineClass
methods.description: Defines a binder class with specified descriptor and transaction handler.

methods.name: makeServiceName
methods.description: Constructs a service name string from an instance identifier.
